title: Choose the visual world for the final deck
question: Five families for a 15-minute rubric-driven talk on a classroom projector. Hero images are stand-ins; Higgsfield art drops in later.

options.label: Approach Plate
options.lineage: aeronautical approach charts and airport diagrams
options.thesis: Every slide is a chart plate: ruled frame, ruler ticks, one orange course line, data labelled in place.
options.viewport: Monumental condensed title left, concentric approach rings and a 4:5 processed hero slot right, plate ID in mono marginalia.
options.risk: Light ground is projector-safe, but reads cold if the linework is thin.

raised.raise: Figures are annotated in place: labels pinned to the mark they describe, never in a legend.

options.label: Flight Strip Rack
options.thesis: The title is literally a clearance: each slide a strip, each RQ a strip in the rack.
options.viewport: One big strip carries the title with a CLEARED stamp; RQ1-3 stack as strips below, hero at right.
options.risk: The pun can feel costume-like if every slide forces a strip.

options.label: Charter Dossier
options.thesis: One monumental processed image, near-black ground, one champagne accent, coordinates and timestamps in the margins.
options.viewport: Full-width 16:7 hero over a wide extended title, ruler rule, tiny mono metadata.
options.risk: Dark slides wash out on bright classroom projectors; needs a light-mode twin for data slides.

options.label: Identity Manual
options.thesis: A colour field, a disc, and a condensed grotesk: the loudest and most legible option.
options.viewport: Blue field, sun disc as hero slot, stacked condensed title, paper footer bar for sources.
options.risk: Evenly bold colour can tip toward pitch deck unless the yellow stays rare.

options.label: One-bit Desktop
options.thesis: Black and white pixels, dither for every tone, window chrome per slide.
options.viewport: Title window over a dithered ground, hero as a PICT window.
options.case: Holds audience identification (dither matches your guardrail); loses on aviation clarity.
options.risk: Retro novelty, and Canva cannot hold true 1-bit dither as native shapes.

options.label: Event Display
options.case: Fuses poorly: graders do not read a physics display as an airline.
options.kept: Figures annotated in place on the mark.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white academic deck, navy headings, figure left, bullets right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other group by design.
